title: Manager skill
item: Manager skill: Claude Code takes Ready tasks and runs them without asking what is next, parks what needs the owner, and reports once
motivation: The owner has about 10 hours a week; asking him what is next, or about every decision, spends them
done_means: A /manage command and its skill exist; a dry run on the seed picks task 20 and changes nothing; agent definitions set model and effort.

decided_for_you.chosen: skill manage, command /manage, agents manager-builder and manager-reviewer; user-invoked (disable-model-invocation: true) like the repo's other skills
decided_for_you.would_change: another skill needing to start a run

decided_for_you.chosen: run reports go in tasks/RUNS.md, newest first, committed on the working branch as 'manage: run report <date>'
decided_for_you.would_change: the file growing past one screen per review

decided_for_you.chosen: parking commits only that task's file on the working branch; the task branch stays
decided_for_you.rejected: leaving the Needs you status on the task branch only, where tasks.py next would not see it
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner wanting parked work merged as far as it got

decided_for_you.chosen: inside an iterate task, the merge / revert question that /iterate always lists under Needs you is answered by the keep rule; any other item parks
decided_for_you.rejected: parking on every item, which parks every iterate task
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner wanting to decide every iterate merge himself

decided_for_you.chosen: the reviewer has Read, Grep and Glob only; for 'script' it names the commands and the manager runs them
decided_for_you.rejected: giving the reviewer Bash, which is not read-only
decided_for_you.would_change: a check the manager cannot run from the reviewer's list

decided_for_you.chosen: one fresh retry means a new builder with the reviewer's findings, then a new reviewer
the merge limit is also checked before taking a task, so no task is built that cannot be merged
decided_for_you.rejected: checking only at the start and before each merge

decided_for_you.chosen: tokens for this task count the headless 'claude -p /manage --dry-run' session used to check done means 3 (116,946 input + output tokens)
decided_for_you.rejected: recording 0 because it was not a subagent
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner counting only Agent-tool runs
